page_title: BAY 2-2 MAI | Bayern Munich v Mainz 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90+5' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

90+4' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
90+3' Here's the latest number of offsides – 6:1.
90+2' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is repeatedly being caught offside.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
88' Wasted effort! Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
87' 2 - 2 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Daniel Batz to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
87' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
85' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kacper Potulski (Mainz) was quite harsh and Robin Braun didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' Kacper Potulski (Mainz) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Robin Braun blows his whistle for a foul. That's a penalty to Bayern Munich! They have a good chance to score now.
85' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
83' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
82' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) tackles a bit over-zealously and Robin Braun blows for a foul. Bayern Munich have been awarded a free kick.
81' Arnaud Nordin (Mainz) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
80' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
79' Daniel Batz pulls off a brilliant save! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved.

79' What a great touch by Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Benedict Hollerbach walks off the pitch to be replaced by Nelson Weiper (Mainz).
77' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
77' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is given a fully deserved yellow card. Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) will miss the next game.
75' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) spurns a great opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. The ball flies narrowly wide of the left post.
73' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Min-Jae Kim as he is replaced by Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich).
72' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
72' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
71' The attendance is 75000.
69' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
69' 17:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. 8:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

67' 1 - 2 Stefan Bell showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header inside the right post. It's 1:2.
67' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Benedict Hollerbach.

64' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Daniel Batz leaps like a salmon to deny him. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
62' Sota Kawasaki (Mainz) is being substituted because of an injury. Urs Fischer sends Arnaud Nordin on the pitch.
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) is replacing Leon Goretzka.
61' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Tom Bischof will be replaced by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich).
61' The substitution is prepared. Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hiroki Ito.
60' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.
60' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) attempts to release Tom Bischof with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
59' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) but poses no threat.
56' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) is caught offside yet again.
55' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) offside.
54' The linesman signals that Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
53' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
51' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) sends a long cross over to Lennart Karl, but Daniel Batz comes forward to gather the ball.
50' Danny da Costa (Mainz) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
50' Sota Kawasaki (Mainz) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
47' Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) plays a long ball to Michael Olise, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
46' The whistle blows and Robin Braun starts the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+5' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Robin Braun signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Mainz players celebrate.
45+4' The Mainz players halt their celebrations as referee Robin Braun makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

45+2' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! William Boving flights the free kick into the box, where Kacper Potulski (Mainz) peels off his marker and heads it straight into the bottom left corner from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:1.
45+1' Robin Braun blows his whistle for a foul after Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) hacks down one of his opponents. Mainz are awarded a free kick.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

43' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
40' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) is penalised for holding. Robin Braun signals a set piece.
39' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
36' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) strikes a volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
35' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempts to find Joshua Kimmich with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
34' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Daniel Batz to make a comfortable save.
32' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
32' The total number of attempts is 9:1. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 5:0.
31' Lennard Maloney (Mainz) connects with the resulting free kick on the edge of the box, but can't find the target as his effort goes high over the bar.
30' Robin Braun interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich). A free kick has been awarded to Mainz.
29' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Serge Gnabry laid the ball off to Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
27' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
24' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) works the corner short.
23' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

23' That was a nice football moment. Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the left post. Daniel Batz guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! Good work from Bayern Munich as they win a corner.
22' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) hits a volley towards goal, but the ball flies straight at the goalkeeper.
22' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
20' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Daniel Batz, who pulls off a stunning save!
20' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Robin Braun blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
17' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the crossbar!
16' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) is caught offside!
16' The ratio of the ball possession is 93:7.
15' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) plays a one-two with Harry Kane, but the move breaks down.
14' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
12' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) attempts to find Josip Stanisic, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

10' Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
8' Flag goes up against Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
7' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a long ball forward to Serge Gnabry, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
6' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Daniel Batz makes a comfortable save.
4' Some neat passing and movement from Bayern Munich as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
3' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
1' William Boving (Mainz) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Robin Braun blows for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
Bayern Munich will kick-off.
Robin Braun will officiate today.
